configuration_commit: Record the commit containing these exact configs separately from pinned engine source 312691d.

warmup_recommendation.standard_synthetic_warmup: Keep source 312691d existing 256-token/two-output warmup over all ten conditions; separately record setup.
warmup_recommendation.reason: Three complete repetitions and longer decode expose first-use variation without changing source, cache state preparation, or hiding startup work.
warmup_recommendation.reporting: All three repetition points, all-three median and min/max, with repetition zero identified. Repetitions one and two stability is descriptive; no outlier removal or substitution.
warmup_recommendation.terminology: First repetition is first observed per condition, not a guaranteed cold-cache trial: prior conditions, standard warmup and persistent compilation caches can already prime work.
warmup_recommendation.later_change: A separately declared per-shape warmup protocol is only justified if repeated evidence remains dominated by startup; any such change creates a new measurement version.

execution_order: Separate source 312691d process per length; deterministic condition order full then StreamingLLM/R-KV/AgentKV each at 80/50/25%, all three repeats consecutive per condition. Each pass resets engine/seed.

bound_rules.allocation: round_up_5min(process + 120s preflight + 30s two kill graces + 30s bounded batch NVML + 120s bookkeeping)
bound_rules.meaning: Planning caps, not forecasts or experimental measurements. Eightfold scaling conservatively charges prefill and orchestration as well as the eightfold decode count.

failure_policy: Retain all 30 cells/90 pass expectations per core length, failures and missing coverage. Any failed cell stops progression to later length/jobs; no free replacement. The 32,600-token feasibility results remain separately reported with all 7 completed and 3 failed conditions; 32,600 is excluded from the new complete timing grid.
comparison_contract: Analyze 64-decode runs together only. Never pool 8-decode feasibility or unpinned 1k smoke with these measurements. Same source/runtime/GPU/cap/threads across every length.

figures.main: Predeclare 50% retention as a central representative setting: one shared-scale curve per full/StreamingLLM/R-KV/AgentKV to show between-method decode cost; label this choice and include full matrix supplement.
figures.full_matrix: Method facets with full/80/50/25, raw repetition points and observed ranges; shared units/axes. No fitted or smoothed trends.
metrics: separate reserved pool and peak total VRAM
figures.semantics: Selection/compaction include prefix+continuation and are nested instrumented totals, not per-token rates or additions to elapsed. Instrumented rates never replace ordinary rates.
figures.limits: One fixed historical trace and technical repetitions; not task-bootstrap intervals, model/task quality, or general workload conclusions.

configurations.evidence_note: Measured single-repeat eight-decode cost is a planning input, not stable repeated timing.
